units.note: 1.000 g of concentrate = 15 drops. drops = round(g_per_litre * 15), half-up.

validation.note: Every Apax recipe totals 4.0 g/L except two documented exceptions (see anomalies). Treat deviation as a warning, never auto-correct.

anomalies.detail: JAMM 2.6 g/L gives a 4.1 g/L total, the only legacy row that breaks the 4.0 invariant. Supplied card says 2.7; the surrounding pattern would suggest 2.5. Shipped as published.
Totals 3.5 g/L. Only exception in the current range. Plausibly a deliberate lighter dilution. Shipped as published.

Legacy Light Roast is JAMM-dominant (3.0) with TONIK 1.0; current Light Roast has JAMM 0.0. Legacy Dark Roast is TONIK-dominant (3.0) with JAMM 0.0; current Dark Roast has TONIK 0.0 and JAMM 2.0. The two roast profiles effectively swapped character between versions, unlike rows 1-4 which were gentle rebalances. Faithfully transcribed from both sources.

supplied_card.description: Printed card shipped with the original 3-concentrate set. Not used as a data source.
supplied_card.variance: Where the archived calculator gives 2.5 / 0.5, the card gives 2.7 / 0.3 — an 8:3:1 ratio against the calculator's 5:2:1. Same recipe shape, same 4.0 g/L total. Card values appear back-calculated from drops-per-200mL-cup. Card contains no Martin Wölfl row.

limited_editions.status: Out of scope for v1. Interaction model with the standard range is unconfirmed — additive, standalone, or substitutive.
